title: Destruction Hammer
description: A hammer that destroys things. That's it.
body:
Have you ever been building that _thing_ that you thought would be cool, but it just **won't work**? What about when you tried making that airplane in Create: Aeronautics? Or that redstone contraption that kept breaking? If these or similar things make you angry (or you just love mayhem), then this mod is for you. Simply put, it adds one thing: a giant hammer that blows things up. 

Just right click on a block, hit a mob, or break a block with the hammer and it will explode basically everything in the area. See the Gallery tab for examples.




Made with MCreator
